items.title: Collect an audio Holotape
items.detail: Audio Holotape on a barrel at The Rusty Pick

items.title: Build Anything in a Shelter
items.detail: Place any item in your C.A.M.P. shelter

items.title: Collect a Burnt Book
items.detail: Burnt Books spawn in burned buildings; Summersville has many

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Join or start a Daily Ops public team and complete the instance

items.title: Kill a Fanatic
items.detail: Fanatics are raiders in The Pitt; reach via Expeditions

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Masked cultists from the Slasher event at cabins and campgrounds

items.title: Pick a Lock
items.detail: Orange locked tool case in first room of West Tek Research Center

items.title: Build a Turret or Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any turret or trap under Defense in build menu

items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Orange bulbs at Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs; can plant in C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Giant Teapot or Tanagra Town cave for reliable spawns

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Appears as uninvited guest at Head Hunt during Slasher event final stage

items.title: Kill a Cultist
items.detail: Up to 34 Cultists at Point Pleasant; target head for weak spot

items.title: Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor
items.detail: Degrade a Protest Sign from Grafton, then repair at workbench with Wood

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at Tinker's Workbench and scrap it

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Crystal
items.detail: Scrap crystal liquor decanters or floater freezer pus sacs at workbench

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint on foot to cover distance faster; fast travel does not count
